approval: User chose Domini negative effects only, immediate energy-2 with low-energy faint, and existing opium-style addiction; no new penalty formula.

edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START CHAOTIC_OPIUM_PENALTY_20261113
dynamic $replace({
 jo9ceactor['neg_spellbound'] += 1
 jo9ceactor_rate['angst'] += max(0, min(jo9ceactor['temper'], jo9ceactor['sensitivity']) - jo9ceactor['moral'] - max(0, jo9ceactor['deprivation_attitude']*5))
 if jo9ceactor['on_opium'] > 0:
  jo9ceactor['opium_addiction'] += 1
 else
  jo9ceactor['on_opium'] = 1
 end
 jo9ceactor['energy'] -= 2
 if jo9ceactor['energy']*2 - jo9ceactor['half_action'] <= 0:
  jo9ceactor_state = CONST_INT['slave_faint']
  jo9ceactor['exhaustion_fainted'] = 1
 end
}, 'jo9ceactor', $jo9_chaotic_role)
! JO9 MOD END CHAOTIC_OPIUM_PENALTY_20261113
chaotic_essence -= 1
